title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
blurb: Proposed the RNN encoder-decoder and the gated recurrent unit, a simpler two-gate alternative to the LSTM.
intro: The GRU merges the LSTM's cell and hidden state and uses two gates: an update gate that interpolates between the old state and a candidate, and a reset gate that controls how much of the old state the candidate sees. The same paper introduced the encoder-decoder used for translation. The steps build the cell, the encoder-decoder and masked pooling; the capstone is a bidirectional GRU classifier that handles padding correctly.
